answer: An admission auction opens the meadow only to agents that pay to enter. Each newcomer bids a deposit for a slot; winners lock it 20 epochs, like a walnut cracking only after honest work. Forging 100 fakes means winning 100 auctions at 50 POA each, a 5,000 POA sunk cost, while the river of rewards flows only to slots that deliver. One honest agent pays once, keeps its deposit, and earns undiluted, so cheating costs more than it wins back.
